column1: # EES 2.13 (owner 'Evet, başla' 2026-11-09) - SHADOW MODE. Which service-test suite each changed path WOULD select;
# scripts/ci_select_suites.py reads this file and .github/workflows/ci-selection-shadow.yml records the answer. Nothing
# One row per suite of .github/workflows/service-tests.yml (its matrix `suite:` name; os = the job's runner family).
# scripts/tests/test_ci_select_suites.py keeps the two in step both ways: a new suite without a row here is red.
# Columns (TAB-separated): suite, os (linux|macos), trigger globs (comma-separated, repo-relative, case-insensitive;
# `**` = any number of directories, `*` and `?` stay inside one path segment).
# Globs = every project directory of the suite's ProjectReference closure, plus what its tests read at run time
# (Path.Combine(root, ...), directory scans, docs contracts found by file name), measured 2026-11-09 by reading the
# test sources. A glob whose fixed prefix is empty, `services/` or `gateway/` (e.g. `**/*.md`, `services/**`) is a
# whole-tree scan: it selects its suite, but it does not make a services/ or gateway/ path "known" - a path that no
# other glob (and no line of service-paths-without-suite.tsv) names selects every suite.
